_doc: Home demo on the pessimistic Plus profile. Numbers are design targets from foundation §4.5, not promises; tighten as the system improves.

home.taps.why: taps on the counter button must reach LVGL

home.page_turns.why: keys and swipes must turn pages

ui.action_to_first_change_ms.p95.why: first visible change after an action (screen idle) <= 350 ms target + margin

mem.internal.min_free_bytes.why: internal RAM floor during the scenario (target 50 KiB on the device once the platform static use is known)
